response.sql:
WITH telescope_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    observstation,
    COUNT(*) as telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
total_telescopes AS (
  SELECT SUM(telescope_count) as total_count
  FROM telescope_counts
),
shares AS (
  SELECT 
    tc.observstation,
    tc.telescope_count,
    tc.telescope_count::NUMERIC / tt.total_count as share
  FROM telescope_counts tc
  CROSS JOIN total_telescopes tt
),
average_share_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT 
  s.observstation,
  s.telescope_count,
  s.share,
  s.share - a.avg_share as gap
FROM shares s
CROSS JOIN average_share_calc a
WHERE s.share > a.avg_share
ORDER BY gap DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The 'average share across observatories' includes only observatories that have at least one telescope. Observatories with zero telescopes are excluded from the average calculation. This is the natural interpretation since the request asks to 'count [each observatory's] telescopes', implying we're working only with observatories that have telescope records.

alternatives.interpretation: Include all observatories from the observatories table (including those with zero telescopes) in the average share calculation. Observatories with no telescopes would have a share of 0.0, which affects the average.
alternatives.sql:
WITH all_observatories AS (
  SELECT observstation FROM observatories
),
telescope_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    observstation,
    COUNT(*) as telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
all_with_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    ao.observstation,
    COALESCE(tc.telescope_count, 0) as telescope_count
  FROM all_observatories ao
  LEFT JOIN telescope_counts tc ON ao.observstation = tc.observstation
),
total_telescopes AS (
  SELECT SUM(COALESCE(tc.telescope_count, 0)) as total_count
  FROM all_observatories ao
  LEFT JOIN telescope_counts tc ON ao.observstation = tc.observstation
),
shares AS (
  SELECT 
    awc.observstation,
    awc.telescope_count,
    awc.telescope_count::NUMERIC / tt.total_count as share
  FROM all_with_counts awc
  CROSS JOIN total_telescopes tt
),
average_share_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT 
  s.observstation,
  s.telescope_count,
  s.share,
  s.share - a.avg_share as gap
FROM shares s
CROSS JOIN average_share_calc a
WHERE s.share > a.avg_share
ORDER BY gap DESC
LIMIT 10;
